label: Rotax 914 baseline dataset (Part B 9-phase mission profile, compressed demo durations)

stages.name: START_WARMUP
stages._source_note: Table 2 phase 1 (0->1700 RPM cold start, oil pressure build-up); throttle/AFR from Table 3/4 Idle column

stages.name: GROUND_IDLE_TAXI
stages._source_note: Table 2 phase 2 (1400-1700 RPM midpoint); Table 3/4 Idle column

stages.name: TAKEOFF
stages._source_note: Table 2/3/4 Takeoff/Full Power column, 115% throttle with enrichener ON

stages.name: CLIMB
stages._source_note: Table 3/4 Climb column (5500-5800 RPM, 108-115% throttle tapering to 100%, midpoint used); altitude_frac=1.0 because climb's purpose is reaching cruise altitude

stages.name: CRUISE_TRANSIT
stages._source_note: Table 2 phase 5 described as max-cruise OR normal-cruise; Normal Cruise column used as representative (5000 RPM, 85% throttle, AFR 13.5-14.5 midpoint)

stages.name: LOITER_ISR
stages._source_note: Table 2's own stated Loiter range midpointed directly (4800-5200 RPM, 65-85% throttle); AFR from closest Economy Cruise column. Dominant/endurance phase -- pair with enable_wear() for degradation demo

stages.name: DESCENT
stages._source_note: Table 3/4 Descent column (est. values per document); altitude_frac partially reduced, not yet at pattern altitude

stages.name: APPROACH_LANDING
stages._source_note: Table 3/4 Approach & Landing column midpointed; document flags this phase as rapid/variable throttle -- use the simulator's dedicated Rapid Throttle Transition scenario here instead of this single steady value for stress-testing misfire/instability detection

stages.name: SHUTDOWN_COOLDOWN
stages._source_note: Table 2 phase 9: idle RPM declining to 0, oil pressure decaying to zero
